requiredVisibleConditions: Exact Australian MY26 2WD dual-cab, declared 80.6 kWh. Black Edge is a 2WD styling/equipment package only and adds no powertrain; no AWD Black Edge claim. Current six-airbag correction is a marketing correction, not an inferred VIN production change.

An exact configuration was dealer-advertised New when checked on 10 October 2026. An advertisement is not physical-stock inspection, an unsold allocation, VIN-equipment verification, accepted order or a guaranteed delivery date. Retrieval time is not an inventory-update timestamp.
Declared battery capacity is not labelled gross or usable. Keep both unresolved fields null; do not reconstruct usable capacity, loaded route range or V2L output from voltage/current arithmetic.

Published maximum payload is 905 kg; occupants, accessories and towball load consume that allowance. Braked towing is 1,800 kg, subject to vehicle, axle, combination, towbar and State limits. Neither figure guarantees simultaneous full cargo and full towing.

The 419 km range is WLTP combined laboratory data, not loaded/towing range. Current-PDF DC times are approximately 36/46 minutes for 10–80% at 300/100 kW stations; vehicle DC maximum is unknown. AC is about 620 minutes, 0–100%, at 11 kW supply with a 10.5 kW onboard charger; all times depend on conditions.

Six airbags are fitted; ANCAP confirms no centre or driver-knee airbag. The EV is unrated. Old eight-airbag publicity and stale embedded knee-airbag rows must not become fitted-equipment or crash-rating claims.

Current manufacturer terms provide seven-year/unlimited-kilometre vehicle and ten-year/unlimited-kilometre original HV-battery cover, with a 70% SOH floor and exclusions/care obligations. Dealer warranty wording cannot replace the terms. No dealer-specific price, membership offer or diesel Musso bonus is included in these summaries.

requiredVisibleConditions: Exact Australian MY26 AWD dual-cab, declared 80.6 kWh. Black Edge is a 2WD styling/equipment package only and adds no powertrain; no AWD Black Edge claim. Current six-airbag correction is a marketing correction, not an inferred VIN production change.

An exact configuration was dealer-advertised New when checked on 10 October 2026. An advertisement is not physical-stock inspection, an unsold allocation, VIN-equipment verification, accepted order or a guaranteed delivery date. Retrieval time is not an inventory-update timestamp.
Declared battery capacity is not labelled gross or usable. Keep both unresolved fields null; do not reconstruct usable capacity, loaded route range or V2L output from voltage/current arithmetic.

Published maximum payload is 805 kg; occupants, accessories and towball load consume that allowance. Braked towing is 2,300 kg, subject to vehicle, axle, combination, towbar and State limits. Neither figure guarantees simultaneous full cargo and full towing.

The 379 km range is WLTP combined laboratory data, not loaded/towing range. Current-PDF DC times are approximately 36/46 minutes for 10–80% at 300/100 kW stations; vehicle DC maximum is unknown. AC is about 620 minutes, 0–100%, at 11 kW supply with a 10.5 kW onboard charger; all times depend on conditions.

Six airbags are fitted; ANCAP confirms no centre or driver-knee airbag. The EV is unrated. Old eight-airbag publicity and stale embedded knee-airbag rows must not become fitted-equipment or crash-rating claims.

Current manufacturer terms provide seven-year/unlimited-kilometre vehicle and ten-year/unlimited-kilometre original HV-battery cover, with a 70% SOH floor and exclusions/care obligations. Dealer warranty wording cannot replace the terms. No dealer-specific price, membership offer or diesel Musso bonus is included in these summaries.
AWD towball download remains null: the current PDF states 230 kg, while current official embedded data states 180 kg. Obtain authoritative vehicle/towbar clarification before using a limit.

Cargo volume is 4,420 L VDA; maximum internal dimensions are not door openings or wheel-arch clearance. The 740 kg maximum payload is not net freight load. Printed tare is 1,955 kg versus kerb 1,910 kg; preserve both declarations and hold normalized masses. Accessories, occupants and loads must fit vehicle limits.

The 416 km range is WLTP combined laboratory data. Approximate DC charging is 30 minutes, 10–80%, with a 350 kW station; vehicle maximum is 128 kW. AC is 390 minutes, 10–100%, with 11 kW supply and a 10.5 kW onboard charger. Times vary with charger, battery and ambient conditions.

The model page advertises eight years/160,000 km, but linked terms specify pre-MY27 seven years/150,000 km and a seven-year/150,000 km Commercial Use cap. No MY26 PV5 exception was found. Confirmed battery years/km remain null; the 70% capacity clause and exclusions do not resolve the duration conflict.

ANCAP Platinum/91% is a 2025 commercial-van collision-avoidance assessment with its source applicability limits, not a crash-star rating. Backover AEB is explicitly unavailable; rear cross-traffic collision avoidance is a different function.

The 750 kg braked-towing declaration is subject to vehicle and towing-equipment limits. GCM and simultaneous maximum freight/towing capacity are unverified; do not derive them from published payload arithmetic.

requiredVisibleConditions: Exact Australian Standard Range 50 kWh complete cargo van. Manufacturer model year remains unverified; advertised 2026 build/compliance year is separate. Use the current linked brochure, generated June 2026 with a 3 March 2026 effective footer; do not invent a VIN changeover.

Bartons advertised this named battery configuration as New on 10 October 2026. Advertised condition, VIN, build/compliance year and equipment were not independently inspected; physical presence, registration history, unsold allocation and delivery are unverified. East Coast stock 39435 is Demo and excluded from clean-new evidence.
Declared battery capacity is not labelled gross or usable. Keep both unresolved fields null; do not reconstruct usable capacity, loaded route range or V2L output from voltage/current arithmetic.

Published payload is 1,338 kg within 3,150 kg GVW, before allowing for occupants, options, accessories and towball load. The claimed 6.95 m³ cargo volume has no identified measurement method; do not compare it directly with VDA litres. Braked towing is 1,000 kg, but GCM, towball and axle limits remain unknown.

The 240 km figure is WLTP combined laboratory range, not a loaded-route guarantee. DC is 26 minutes, 20–80%, at a 100 kW station; vehicle DC maximum is 100 kW. AC is 4 hours, 15–100%, at 11 kW. Times are ideal-condition claims affected by temperature, battery condition and available charger output.

Current exact Bartons ads say three seats, but the reviewed official specification does not state a count; keep seating dealer-supported pending confirmation. The current official matrix explicitly specifies heated/ventilated driver seating only; passenger heating/ventilation is unverified.

Published warranty limits are five years/200,000 km for the vehicle and eight years/200,000 km for the HV battery, whichever occurs first. The full supplied booklet was not obtained; battery-retention threshold, complete exclusions and exact service interval remain unresolved.

No price is included in the headline summaries. Expired July–August homepage promotion terms must not be treated as current; the separate September–October offer retains its eligibility and delivery conditions. East Coast stock 39435 is Demo, despite its old syndicated New/0 km advert.

requiredVisibleConditions: Exact Australian Extended Range 66 kWh complete cargo van. Manufacturer model year remains unverified; advertised 2026 build/compliance year is separate. Use the current linked brochure, generated June 2026 with a 3 March 2026 effective footer; do not invent a VIN changeover.

Bartons advertised this named battery configuration as New on 10 October 2026. Advertised condition, VIN, build/compliance year and equipment were not independently inspected; physical presence, registration history, unsold allocation and delivery are unverified. East Coast stock 39435 is Demo and excluded from clean-new evidence.
Declared battery capacity is not labelled gross or usable. Keep both unresolved fields null; do not reconstruct usable capacity, loaded route range or V2L output from voltage/current arithmetic.

Published payload is 1,208 kg within 3,150 kg GVW, before allowing for occupants, options, accessories and towball load. The claimed 6.95 m³ cargo volume has no identified measurement method; do not compare it directly with VDA litres. Braked towing is 1,000 kg, but GCM, towball and axle limits remain unknown.

The 329 km figure is WLTP combined laboratory range, not a loaded-route guarantee. DC is 33 minutes, 20–80%, at a 100 kW station; vehicle DC maximum is 97 kW. AC is 5 hours, 15–100%, at 11 kW. Times are ideal-condition claims affected by temperature, battery condition and available charger output.

Current exact Bartons ads say three seats, but the reviewed official specification does not state a count; keep seating dealer-supported pending confirmation. The current official matrix explicitly specifies heated/ventilated driver seating only; passenger heating/ventilation is unverified.

Published warranty limits are five years/200,000 km for the vehicle and eight years/200,000 km for the HV battery, whichever occurs first. The full supplied booklet was not obtained; battery-retention threshold, complete exclusions and exact service interval remain unresolved.

No price is included in the headline summaries. Expired July–August homepage promotion terms must not be treated as current; the separate September–October offer retains its eligibility and delivery conditions. East Coast stock 39435 is Demo, despite its old syndicated New/0 km advert.

MY27 is explicit in the Twin Swing dealer ad; the manufacturer's 2027 URL alone does not establish a formal MY or a Liftback-specific MY. Expanded door indexes are duplicates, not additional vehicles.

Current official Liftback offering is established, but no exact Liftback dealer-New VIN was verified. The Twin Swing advertisement and unresolved-door Suttons listing cannot fill that gap. Physical presence, unsold allocation, order acceptance and delivery timing remain unverified.
Declared battery capacity is not labelled gross or usable. Keep both unresolved fields null; do not reconstruct usable capacity, loaded route range or V2L output from voltage/current arithmetic.

The claimed 20-minute DC time is approximate, 10–80% SOC, at a 350 kW-rated station. The PDF also labels 350 kW a maximum capacity; that raw declaration is retained, but vehicle-side peak acceptance stays null. At 100/50 kW stations the same SOC window is 41/81 minutes. AC is 455 minutes and portable 230 V/10 A charging 33 hours, both 10–100%; actual times vary.

The common declaration is 1,005 kg payload, 2,268–2,345 kg kerb mass and 3,350 kg GVM; exact per-door masses are not supplied. Do not substitute 1,082 kg from the lightest kerb figure. People, options and accessories consume allowance. Braked towing is 2,000 kg with required extra-cost genuine equipment; GCM and simultaneous full payload/full tow remain unknown.

The 4,935 L main cargo bay is VDA; the separate 23.9 L front compartment has no stated measurement method and is not added to it. The 450 km range is WLTP laboratory data, not loaded-work range. Consumption carries a separate shared ADR81/02 footnote caveat; do not relabel it WLTP.

ANCAP explicitly leaves Electric unrated; the mixed-family five-star badge does not apply. Commercial-van vehicle warranty is five years/160,000 km regardless of use; HV battery is eight years/160,000 km, whichever first, with below-70% SOH and maintenance conditions. Replacement need not restore as-new capacity.
Liftback is the standard rear-door configuration and includes a rear wiper. Both door records belong to one Electric grade; diesel, hybrid and overseas passenger equipment must not transfer.

hyundai_staria_load_electric_84_fwd_lift.configuration: Australian Hyundai STARIA Load Electric Electric 84 kWh FWD Liftback; exact sourced configuration, delivered VIN/equipment epoch requires confirmation

requiredVisibleConditions: Exact Australian Twin Swing rear-door configuration of the single Electric 84 kWh FWD grade, from the September 2026 specification. MY27 is explicit in the Twin Swing dealer ad; the manufacturer's 2027 URL alone does not establish a formal MY or a Liftback-specific MY. Expanded door indexes are duplicates, not additional vehicles.

An exact configuration was dealer-advertised New when checked on 10 October 2026. An advertisement is not physical-stock inspection, an unsold allocation, VIN-equipment verification, accepted order or a guaranteed delivery date. Retrieval time is not an inventory-update timestamp.
Declared battery capacity is not labelled gross or usable. Keep both unresolved fields null; do not reconstruct usable capacity, loaded route range or V2L output from voltage/current arithmetic.

The claimed 20-minute DC time is approximate, 10–80% SOC, at a 350 kW-rated station. The PDF also labels 350 kW a maximum capacity; that raw declaration is retained, but vehicle-side peak acceptance stays null. At 100/50 kW stations the same SOC window is 41/81 minutes. AC is 455 minutes and portable 230 V/10 A charging 33 hours, both 10–100%; actual times vary.

The common declaration is 1,005 kg payload, 2,268–2,345 kg kerb mass and 3,350 kg GVM; exact per-door masses are not supplied. Do not substitute 1,082 kg from the lightest kerb figure. People, options and accessories consume allowance. Braked towing is 2,000 kg with required extra-cost genuine equipment; GCM and simultaneous full payload/full tow remain unknown.

The 4,935 L main cargo bay is VDA; the separate 23.9 L front compartment has no stated measurement method and is not added to it. The 450 km range is WLTP laboratory data, not loaded-work range. Consumption carries a separate shared ADR81/02 footnote caveat; do not relabel it WLTP.

ANCAP explicitly leaves Electric unrated; the mixed-family five-star badge does not apply. Commercial-van vehicle warranty is five years/160,000 km regardless of use; HV battery is eight years/160,000 km, whichever first, with below-70% SOH and maintenance conditions. Replacement need not restore as-new capacity.

Twin Swing is a factory rear-door option and omits the rear wiper; no unverified option-price or door-opening-angle claim is made. Both door records belong to one Electric grade; diesel, hybrid and overseas passenger equipment must not transfer.

strength.label: Twin doors and charge-time claim
strength.text: Optional Twin Swing rear doors accompany a 4,935 L VDA bay and a claimed 20-minute 10–80% DC charge with a 350 kW station.

tradeoff.label: Rear wiper and payload limits
tradeoff.text: Twin Swing has no rear wiper; its 1,005 kg payload is not door-specific, and the Electric remains ANCAP-unrated.
